runs.objective: Click 'Add to Cart', then in the cart click 'Proceed to Checkout', and verify that 'Secure Checkout' is displayed.
runs.summary:
The agent took an extra Update action on the cart item before trying to check out. That action put this test run into the displayed disabled-checkout state, so the required checkout step could not be completed.
Remove the cart-quantity update from this scenario. After Add to Cart opens the cart, click Proceed to Checkout and then check for Secure Checkout.
